# ink (vendored)

Source of the ink narrative scripting language by inkle Ltd, version 1.2.1,
from https://github.com/inkle/ink (tag `v1.2.1`). MIT licensed — see `LICENSE.txt`.

Only `ink-engine-runtime` (runtime) and `compiler` are included. Local changes:
project files trimmed to a single `netstandard2.0` target with packaging metadata removed.
No source files were modified.
